[h1]The best game with the worst developers.[/h1]
That is the best game I've ever played. But...
Constant lags and server crashes. Cheaters reset servers, you have to start from the beginning. Also cheaters teleport to you, join your guild by themself, kick you and demolish your base one click of a button.
I've achieved everything, caught so many different pals, mined thousands of resources and had to start all over again every time. I'm sick of it. Until I see a patch note that fixes these things, I'm not coming back.
And don't tell me about Single Player. I have no interest in playing in a dead world with no people.
Oh, and the multiplayer feature itself involves playing with people. Just remove this feature if you can't improve it, don't mess with people's minds. I am not a hater of this game and never will be, so I put a positive review, just asking the developers to do their job. You have released 1-2 patches for the entire time of the game and then keep quiet, do not update or release anything. You don't even mention that you hear people and see their problems and work on fixing them.

[b]Please, let's collect as many ratings as possible under this review and complain in the comments under it to let the developers know about the game's problems and make them do something.[/b]
